title: Smart112Incident
description: Authoritative contract schema representing an emergency 112 incident record.

caller_text.description: Raw or transcribed text provided by the caller or reporting entity.

caller_phone.description: E.164 formatted contact telephone number of the caller if available.

category.description: High-level classification of the emergency service domain.

severity_level.description: Calculated emergency triage severity level. Client calculation forbidden.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the emergency incident.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates of the emergency location.

accuracy_meters.description: Estimated spatial horizontal accuracy radius in meters.

address.description: Reverse-geocoded or caller-stated human-readable street address.

landmark.description: Nearby landmark, cross-street, or descriptive reference point.

requires_human_review.description: Mandatory flag indicating whether a human dispatcher must manually verify triage/AI inference.

source_channel.description: Ingestion origin of the emergency report.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of incident ingestion.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last incident modification.
